newsitem.title: UK: Amey consortium wins PFI road contract.
newsitem.headline: Amey consortium wins PFI road contract.

text.p: Autolink, a consortium comprising Amey, Taylor Woodrow and Sir Robert McAlpine, has been awarded a design, build finance and operate (DBFO) contract for the A19 Dishforth to Tyne Tunnel road, the department of transport said.
The contract, structured under the government's Private Finance Initiative (PFI), covers 74 miles of the road in the north east of England.
Autolink will take responsibility for the road, including upgrading a section of it to alleviate congestion on a section near the River Tees viaduct.
Autolink will receive payments from the government based on traffic, with different "shadow" tolls payable according to the level of use.
There will be a ceiling on the amount of shadow tolls payable.
Autolink will take over operation and maintenance of the road in early 1997, the ministry statement added.
